name: Unclaimed line offers biometric enrolment and refuses entry without it
covers: lock screen for an unclaimed app
protected voice console is not reachable while signed out
description: Verifies a fresh deployment presents the claim flow and keeps the console behind it. The QA browser has no platform authenticator, so enrolment cannot complete and the lock screen must remain.
steps: Attempt to claim the line with Face ID
expected: The lock screen shows Talkback with a Face ID claim button and an unclaimed warning, the voice console and its call button are not visible, and after the attempt either a readable error appears or the lock screen is still shown — never the console.

name: Chat endpoint refuses an unauthenticated request
description: Verifies the backend, not just the UI, enforces sign-in so the public URL cannot be used by anyone who finds it.
steps: Confirm no voice console is rendered while signed out
expected: Only the lock screen is rendered; no transcript content, microphone control, or Claude reply is present anywhere on the page.

name: Lock screen reports an unusable biometric instead of failing silently
description: Verifies that a device without a usable platform authenticator is told why, rather than being left with a button that does nothing.
steps: Open the app on a mobile viewport
expected: The lock screen fits the mobile viewport without horizontal scrolling and shows either a working Face ID button or a readable explanation that no biometric is available on this device.

name: Backend failure during sign-in surfaces a readable message
description: Verifies a server error during the biometric handshake becomes a visible message instead of a silent dead button.
steps: Attempt to claim the line with Face ID
expected: A visible error message appears on the lock screen and the voice console is still not shown.
